targets.name: Lizard relief in the upper beam
targets.concealment: The low-relief cedar lizard matches the beam grain and curls along ornamental scrollwork under the skylight.

targets.name: Mouse relief above the lattice
targets.concealment: Its small cedar body is part of a scrolling floral frieze, while its curled tail repeats the surrounding carved tendrils.

targets.name: Dragonfly on the lattice
targets.concealment: Its four wood-grain wings lie at the angles of crossing lattice strips and curled leaves, reducing the insect silhouette.

targets.name: Butterfly on the right lattice
targets.concealment: The narrow patterned cedar wings match nearby flower petals and diagonal openwork, while one wing overlaps the lattice.

targets.name: Hanging pinecone beneath cedar leaves
targets.concealment: Its brown scales repeat the foliage and carved leaf textures; cedar fronds partly overlap its upper edge high in the lattice.

targets.name: Small fox relief on the cabinet
targets.concealment: The animal is embedded in a medallion of curling cedar leaves, with its tail and body blending into deep warm grain.

targets.name: Snail relief on the lower cabinet
targets.concealment: The spiral shell is nestled among matching curled leaf reliefs near the bench shadow; its low body merges with a carved stem.

targets.name: Tall mushroom carving
targets.concealment: Both cedar mushrooms are fitted into a narrow foliage panel, with caps and stems repeating the surrounding brown curls and grooves.

targets.name: Fish relief among cedar leaves
targets.concealment: Its scales and fins are carved into the same panel as veined leaves, beneath the curved bench edge and deep shadow.

targets.name: Leaf-tailed wooden lizard
targets.concealment: Its long cedar body and curled tail lie diagonally in a tray of tan wood shavings with matching curved edges and carved leaves.

targets.name: Wooden dragonfly in the front tray
targets.concealment: Its veined cedar wings overlap loose leaf carvings and curled shavings of similar tone, with the body angled across the tray.

targets.name: Blue enamel mug
targets.concealment: The exposed dark blue mug is a strong color anchor on the left shelf.

targets.name: Red tied cloth bundle
targets.concealment: A large red tied bundle rests clearly on the right bench.

targets.name: Green oil can
targets.concealment: The broad green oil can is exposed at the front of the workbench, with a long slanted spout.

targets.name: Leather work gloves
targets.concealment: The large pale work gloves lie openly across the front left edge of the bench.

review.notes: All fifteen actual targets inspected in source-context overlays, with enlarged coordinate grids correcting full animal and insect silhouettes, mushroom stem, snail body, oil-can spout and vessel handle holes. An uncertain box figure was removed in favor of the actual hanging pinecone. Eleven authored challenging placements and four clear color anchors. Phone playtesting pending.
